items.name: ISMO: Live!
items.caption:
The Finnish wordsmith behind Netflix special ISMO: No Words is touring in English.
ISMO performs at Houston Improv on December 31, 2026. He won the 2014 Funniest Person in the World competition. Tickets on sale now. Link in bio.
